metadata.description: Training data for BTC/USDC trading neural network with actual profit/loss outcomes

output_structure.buy_outcome: BUY order outcome: +1.0 (hit +0.7% target), -1.0 (hit -0.4% stop), 0.0 (no target hit)
output_structure.sell_outcome: SELL order outcome: +1.0 (hit +0.7% target), -1.0 (hit -0.4% stop), 0.0 (no target hit)

trading_rules.evaluation_logic: Both BUY and SELL orders evaluated independently to completion - answers 'what if we only placed BUY?' and 'what if we only placed SELL?'

candle_data.description: 120 consecutive 1-minute candles, each with 8 features (OHLC, volume, timestamp, color, body_size)

studies_data.description: Technical indicators for 120 candles: SMA, EMA, RSI for each candle

patterns_data.description: Candlestick pattern detection: 119 single patterns + 118 sliding window patterns

global_context.description: Global parameters: duration (1min) and window size (120)

training_data.features: an array of 1559 normalized feature valu es
training_data.description: BUY order would hit +0.7% target (profit), SELL order would hit -0.4% stop (loss) - both evaluated independently

training_data.features: an array of 1559 normalized feature values
training_data.description: SELL order would hit +0.7% target (profit), BUY order would hit -0.4% stop (loss) - both evaluated independently
